title: Motivation vs Habit
topic: Why motivation fades and habits compound
core_message: Motivation arrives with a lot of energy and loses some every day. A habit starts small but gets a small push every day, so it keeps rising. Over time the small, repeated push beats the big start.
central_insight: Small, every day, beats big, once.
visual_metaphor: Two balls side by side. Motivation (ivory) is dropped from a great height and bounces lower every time until it lies still. Habit (gold) starts with a small bounce, gets a small push each time, and climbs until it rises past the line where motivation started.
narration_style: calm, matter-of-fact, a slight lift on the last line

narration.text: Motivation drops you in from a great height.
Habit starts small. But it gets a push every day.
Small, every day, beats big, once.

caption_density: one short line per sentence; nothing during the end card

captions.text: Motivation drops you in from a great height.

beats.note: motivation bounces lower each time and comes to rest
habit crosses motivation's starting line; the line lights gold

loop_design: no loop: ends on the brand card
